text: I’d like you to make a set of plant slides, and I’m probably over-explaining because I’m worried they’ll end up looking like they belong to different sets. Please keep the exact same sage-green-and-cream linocut style throughout, with the same border, lettering, paper texture and pot shape on every slide. These should be four square Instagram carousel slides, with Monstera, Snake plant, Pothos, and Peace lily in that order. Put one plant and its name on each slide. What I mean by keeping them consistent is that only the plant and its name should change, not any of the surrounding design or the pot. Please send the slides separately.
